The '''Quexius''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Color/Legends|green-and-red]] [[Bird/Legends|birds]] native to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The bird was aggressive and would often peck at nearby beings for no reason. It was also an incredibly stupid bird that would antagonize predators. For this reason, the Quexius was an endangered species.
